subject: CS364
filterSummary: Successfully selected 5 English and 4 Arabic videos. The English candidates offered strong, directly relevant options for all topics. The Arabic selection was challenging due to a lack of specific content; for 'Software Patentability and Algorithms', no suitable video was found. For other Arabic topics, the best available, tangentially related videos were chosen to provide some coverage.
